newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's OLS Group seen raising HK$200 mln in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's OLS Group seen raising HK$200 mln in IPO.

text.p: Construction concern OLS Group Ltd is expected to raise about HK$200 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong later next week, financing its existing and prospective projects, analysts said.

The company is expected to issue new shares at HK$1.65 each, representing a price to earnings multiple of 7.6 times on a prospective fully-diluted basis, analysts said after attended a company presentation on Friday.

About HK$83 million of the proceed is expected to be used to finance seven of its existing Hong Kong projects, HK$83 million for four of its China projects, HK$8 million for Malaysia, and the balance for prospective projects, they said.
The IPO is expected to run from June 17 to 20 with dealing in the company shares to begin on June 26. Natwest is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, analysts said.

OLS had posted a profit after tax of HK$68.74 million for the year ended in December 1996, HK$50.33 million in 1995 and HK$40.89 million in 1994. Its operating revenue was HK$509.92 million in 1996, HK$393.84 million in 1995 and HK$421.47 million in 1994, analysts said.

OLS Group engages in specialist construction contracting in "alterations and additions" - the process of restructing, remodelling and refurbishing works done to existing buildings - and "fit-outs" - the process of finishing the interior or exterior of buildings, they said.

The outstanding contract on hands amounted to HK$572 million as at May 31, 1997, including six projects worth HK$108.06 million in China, 19 Hong Kong projects worth HK$451.3 million and one HK$12.7 million project in Malaysia, they added.
